rules.question: Does code follow patterns already present in the repository?
Is the code free of circular dependencies?
rules.applies_if: Importing modules or classes between packages/directories

rules.question: Does the domain refrain from importing concrete drivers?
Do side effects route through ports and adapters?
rules.applies_if: I/O, database, network, or file system operations

rules.question: Do handlers only handle parsing, invocation, and serialization?
rules.applies_if: HTTP controllers, gRPC handlers, or message listeners

rules.question: Does every handler stay under 30 lines when applicable?
Is business logic kept out of handlers?
Is pure logic separated from side effects?
Are command and query responsibilities separated?
Are source files over 200 lines split before implementation rather than waived for urgency, legacy, or minimal-diff reasons?
rules.applies_if: Adding or modifying source files over 200 lines

rules.question: Does cognitive complexity stay within 15?
Does cyclomatic complexity stay within 10?
Do routines have at most three parameters?
Is decision nesting limited to at most two levels?
Are redundant else blocks absent?
rules.applies_if: Use of guard clauses or early returns

rules.question: Do modules have cohesive responsibility?
rules.applies_if: Creating or modifying modules and classes

rules.question: Are public interfaces compact relative to private logic?
Is inheritance depth limited to at most one level?
Is composition preferred over inheritance where appropriate?
Are speculative abstractions absent?
rules.applies_if: Introducing new patterns, interfaces, or generics

rules.question: Do factories, strategies, and interfaces exist only for actual variability or a second implementation?
rules.applies_if: Using creational or structural design patterns

rules.question: Do mutable canonical values have a single owner?
rules.applies_if: Managing application state or in-memory data

rules.question: Is feature-specific logic kept out of shared modules?
Are pass-through wrappers without value absent?
Does refactoring genuinely reduce reader cognitive overhead?
Are isolated conditional patches absent from unrelated flows?
rules.applies_if: Modifying existing flows with added if/switch conditions

rules.question: Are repeated conditions on the same model free from indicating a missing dispatcher or domain model?
Is dead code, unused variables, or legacy compatibility code absent?
Does the change refrain from unnecessarily mixing refactoring with new functionality?
Does the change remain a single verifiable logical unit?
Was an existing utility reused before creating a new one?
Would a standard library or native solution have avoided new code?
Was a new dependency genuinely necessary?
Is every deliberate simplification with a known constraint documented?
Does modified code refrain from leaving obsolete branches or pass-throughs?
rules.applies_if: Modifying or deprecating old code paths

rules.question: Is the code no harder to understand than before?
Do names communicate the role and domain meaning of modified functions, variables, and types?
Is behavior kept near the data it primarily uses instead of reaching through another module's internals?
rules.applies_if: Methods or functions that traverse another object's data or services

rules.question: Is duplicated business or transformation logic avoided across modified modules?
rules.applies_if: Adding logic similar to existing logic in another location

rules.question: Does one logical change avoid scattering coordinated edits across unrelated files or layers?
rules.applies_if: A single behavior change requires repeated edits in multiple locations

rules.question: Does each modified module have one coherent reason to change?
rules.applies_if: Modules or classes changed for unrelated concerns

rules.question: Are long chains of object or service navigation hidden behind a meaningful boundary?
rules.applies_if: Deep chained property, method, or service access

rules.question: Do subclasses and implementations honor the contract they inherit instead of refusing most of it?
Are repeatedly co-occurring parameters or fields represented as a meaningful value object when that reduces coupling?
rules.applies_if: The same group of values travels through multiple APIs or functions

rules.question: Do query methods avoid observable mutation?
rules.applies_if: Methods or interfaces with read/query responsibilities

rules.question: Do command methods return only acknowledgement instead of mixing mutation with read-model results?
rules.applies_if: Methods or interfaces with command/write responsibilities

rules.question: Before introducing a durable abstraction, was a viable simpler design compared?
rules.applies_if: Adding a new abstraction, interface, factory, strategy, or layer

rules.question: Does shared code serve the same domain model, ownership, and change cadence, with context mapping when those differ?
rules.applies_if: Sharing code or types across bounded contexts or independently owned modules
